name: Wadamesh-tak beta_99.58
body:
**Wadamesh-tak beta_99.58**: fork build 58 on top of Wadamesh beta_99, adding MeshCore Open TAK photos and voice, OTP Messenger and Team. Built from `a50694f53a8a64c83666b27df841ad0a0adfed5c`.

Boards: T-Deck, ThinkNode M9, T-LoRa Pager (SX1262 or LR1121), T-Display P4 AMOLED (SX1262 or LR2021; `-at` for units whose C6 still runs the factory ESP-AT). First USB install on any board: flash the `-merged.bin` at 0x0 (the plain `.bin` only suits a board already running this fork; the Pager needs this once for its bigger app slots, the P4 because its app starts at 0x20000). Identity, contacts and channels are kept; on-device settings and saved Wi-Fi reset. P4: the plain variant unless its C6 still runs the factory ESP-AT. If the screen stays black after flashing, unplug the board and plug it back in.

Fork devices install this from **Settings > About > Install update**. To flash by USB, use a `-merged.bin`. Every app image carries a `.sig` that the device checks before installing.
